newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Trustco sets C$400 million in new bonds.
newsitem.headline: Canada Trustco sets C$400 million in new bonds.

text.p: Canada Trustco Mortgage Co, a unit of CT Financial Services Inc, set C$400 million in new bonds on financial markets, lead manager CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc said on Wednesday.

The first tranche of the issue, C$250 million in 5.2 percent bonds due January 31, 2000, was priced at C$99.896 with a yield of 5.237, 23 basis points over the Government of Canada's 5.5 perent due February, 2000.
A second tranche of C$150 million in 6.05 percent bonds due January 31, 2002, was priced at C$99.805 with a yield of 6.095 percent, 34 basis points above the yield curve.
The comparable government bond for the 6.05 percent issue due January 31, 2002 was the Government of Canada's 9.75 percent bond due December, 2001.
The C$400 million in bonds, which pay interest on July 31 and January 31, will be delivered on January 20, 1997.
